sloka: ददौ च अस्त्राणि दिव्यानि यस्मै ब्रह्मा महा ओजसे ।दानव इन्द्रम् हतम् दृष्ट्वा तिमि ध्वज सुतम् रणे ॥२-४४-११॥
transliteration: dadau ca astrāṇi divyāni yasmai brahmā mahā ojase ।dānava indram hatam dṛṣṭvā timi dhvaja sutam raṇe ॥2-44-11॥

translations.english: To the mighty, heroic Rama, that best of men, Brahmalike Viswamitra has bequeathed many divine weapons, seeing him slay Timidhwaja's son (Subahu), lord of demons, in the battle. He will stay fearless in the forest, relying on the strength of his own arms as though he were living in the palace.
